name: Correct Answer with High Confidence
description: Evaluates a student with average baseline knowledge who answers correctly and reports high confidence, successfully reaching the mastery threshold.

name: Incorrect Answer with Low Confidence
description: Evaluates a student with baseline knowledge who answers incorrectly and reports low confidence, resulting in a low posterior state triggering foundational remediation.

name: Mastery State with Low Confidence (Careless Slip / Guess check)
description: Evaluates a student with near-certain mastery history who reports low confidence despite a correct answer, triggering an ASK action to verify understanding.

name: Uncertain/Partial Knowledge State
description: Evaluates a struggling student who gets a correct answer, landing their posterior in the middle uncertainty band and triggering a scaffolded hint.
